Rationale for [SWS_ComM_00151]:
• The
Communication
Mode
COMM_SILENT_COMMUNICATION
and

modes/sub-states are only necessary for synchronization with AUTOSAR
NM.
• The Communication Mode COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION_WITH_WAKEUP_RE-
QUEST is only necessary to request the lower layer to trigger a wake-up on the
network (e.g. Ethernet hardware compliant to [2, OA TC10]). This mode could
not be requested by a user.
